question: What's the best off-the-shelf training content library that integrates with Workday or SAP SuccessFactors?
text:
If you mean a ready-made corporate learning catalog that plugs directly into Workday Learning or SAP SuccessFactors Learning, my shortlist would be:

Provider	Best for	Workday	SuccessFactors	My take
Udemy Business	Broad skills, tech, business, fast-changing topics	✅	✅	Best overall for breadth + integration
Coursera for Business	High-quality professional/academic learning, AI/data/business	✅	✅	Best for premium/deep learning
LinkedIn Learning	General business, leadership, productivity, Microsoft/tech	✅	✅	Best general-purpose enterprise library
Go1	Aggregating many publishers into one catalog	✅	✅	Best if you want a content marketplace/aggregator
Skillsoft Percipio	Leadership, compliance, IT, cybersecurity	✅	✅	Best for structured enterprise/IT learning
OpenSesame	Very broad multi-publisher catalog	✅	✅	Best for catalog breadth and niche subjects

Workday currently lists Coursera, Go1, LinkedIn Learning, OpenSesame, Pluralsight, Skillsoft Percipio and Udemy Business among its supported external-content providers, with newer providers also being added through its Cloud Connect for Learning platform. 
D
doc.workday.com
+1

My recommendation

I'd pick Udemy Business if you want one library to cover the largest range of employee development needs. Its Workday integration can sync the catalog, completions/progress and skills, with SSO and access through Workday; its SuccessFactors integration similarly supports course discovery, activity tracking and reporting. 
M
marketplace-setup.workday.com
+2

I'd pick Coursera instead if content quality and depth matter more than sheer breadth. Coursera has direct integrations with both Workday and SAP SuccessFactors and supports learner activity/progress tracking. 
C
coursera.org

LinkedIn Learning is particularly compelling if your workforce already lives in the Microsoft/LinkedIn ecosystem and you want a polished, broad library. Workday supports it as an external content provider, including completion tracking. 
W
Workday Documentation
+1

One important distinction: Go1/OpenSesame are more like content aggregators, whereas Udemy, Coursera, LinkedIn Learning and Skillsoft primarily bring their own substantial content ecosystems. If your objective is "give me one contract that gets me lots of publishers", I'd investigate Go1/OpenSesame first.

If you tell me (a) Workday vs. SuccessFactors, (b) employee count, and (c) your top 3 content areas (e.g. leadership, AI/tech, compliance), I can rank the top 3 vendors and give you a feature/price/integration comparison.
